time distance to the current pregnancy
Type of prior cesarean section (elective vs. emergency)
short time interval between prior CS and current pregnancy
Time interval between prior cesarean section and current pregnancy
cohort: 264 pregnant women (86 with CSP and 178 controls with normal pregnancies)
finding: Advanced maternal age, history of abortions and D&C, elective prior cesarean section, and short time interval between prior cesarean section and current pregnancy were significant risk factors for CSP.
mod_finding: Elective prior cesarean section and short time interval between prior cesarean section and current pregnancy were significant risk factors for CSP.
